svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 609 mm square blank; flutes running the way the flaps fold up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark a 30 mm line in from each edge; score it on the inside face 1 mm deep

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut out the four 30 mm corner squares; fold the flaps up to 90 deg

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tray is 549 mm square outside, 541 mm inside: 1 mm clear of the panels

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill four 5.5 mm holes, 200 mm from the centre each way, for the feet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: the four panels stand on the floor inside the flaps

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 539 mm square of card drops in with a finger gap all round
